about.title: About Crypto Tab
ui.automaticUpdates: Updates automatically while this tab is visible.
about.origin: It started with two friends curious about Bitcoin. The idea was simple: a New Tab page for vibe investors who want a feel for the bigger picture.
about.wish: Today, you can follow Bitcoin, Ether, customize your theme, colors, and more.
about.averagesExplanation: The 1W and 1M charts use daily averages. The 1Y and ALL charts use monthly averages. This smooths out short-term price spikes and dips so broader trends are easier to follow.
about.averagesExtremes: The highlighted highs and lows are averages too, so they may differ from the highest and lowest prices recorded during the selected period.
about.history: First shipped in October 2017, maintained on and off ever since, and somehow grew organically to thousands of active installs!
about.contactBefore: We’ve worked together for 10+ years, building browser extensions, mobile apps, and Web3 apps at
